channel: tooling/_threads/Question about topping up a validator. I
searchText: yes, it should still be valid even if your signature and withdrawal_credentials are empty. Assuming you had a valid deposit before for that validator. Beaconchain is also showing this on their dashboard, if you click on dashboard/deposits and hover next to the validity field. also if you navigate to your specific top up deposit, it should be decoded for a successful beaconchain deposit with withdrawal cred 0x00.. Ok. Thanks. Yes my validator is already running and attesting about from a year now.
